title: Global oceanic shark and ray abundance (index, 1970=100)

source.name: Half a century of global decline in oceanic sharks and rays

notes: Relative abundance index derived from the study's finding of a 71% decline in global oceanic shark and ray abundance from 1970 to 2018, driven by an 18-fold increase in relative fishing pressure. Intermediate-year values are approximate interpolations of the published trend, not exact study figures.
